scope: T02 harness security fixes + adversarial behavior regressions (injected verifyMessage/clock/resolver seams, synthetic signatures). Zero network/wallet/transaction.

defects_fixed.root_cause: browser harness verifyChallenge never checked issuedAtMs <= now
defects_fixed.fix: harness.mjs verifyChallenge now enforces finite integer timestamps and FUTURE_ISSUANCE

defects_fixed.root_cause: harness only checked elapsed-since-issue, not expiresAtMs - issuedAtMs <= 5m
defects_fixed.fix: 0 < TTL <= MAX_CHALLENGE_TTL_MS enforced before the SDK call

defects_fixed.root_cause: no single-use nonce tracking or overlap guard in the harness
defects_fixed.fix: consumedNonces Set (consume once on success) + verifyingNonces synchronous in-flight reservation (overlapping awaits cannot both pass)

defects_fixed.root_cause: sameAccountAcrossSessions counted SIGN_IN_EVENT + CONNECTED from one connect as two sessions
defects_fixed.fix: comparator ignores SIGN_IN_EVENT and requires a DISCONNECTED/SIGNED_OUT boundary between two CONNECTED rows; disconnect/account-switch/candidate-switch invalidate signed state

additional_fixes.root_cause: the ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND exception for a not-yet-funded implicit account was applied even without the fixture flag, bypassing live resolver denial
additional_fixes.fix: the exception is now gated behind allowLocalImplicitFallback === true (fixture-only); otherwise ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND denies (fail-closed)
nonce is reserved synchronously before the access-key await and released on failure, so await-interleaved verifications of one nonce cannot both consume it
session table renders wallet-returned accountId/publicKey via textContent (never innerHTML)

regression_results.verify:t02-adversarial: 11/11 PASS (new: scripts/verify-t02-adversarial.mjs; real harness behavior via injected seams)

limits: W03/G02/G03 and any live NEAR Connect / NEAR Auth signature remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL (need human + real wallet); not claimed live.
consumedNonces is in-memory per page load (probe scope); production must persist nonce consumption atomically in the DB (noted in source).
no commit/push, no deployment, no financial action.
